name: A10 - Langes Gespraech ohne Themenverlust
simulation_scenario: You play the auto repair shop on the phone. The agent is calling on behalf of its client to schedule a repair appointment (the agent's mandate: an appointment Monday through Wednesday, 1 PM to 5 PM, up to $60). The conversation should use the full allowed turn count (up to 20 turns) and go through these four phases in exactly this order: (1) Follow-up questions - at the start, ask several genuine follow-up questions about the job (vehicle make/model, license plate, desired scope of service, whether the customer will wait on-site) and wait for a concrete answer each time before continuing. (2) Objection - then raise a clear objection to the mandate, e.g. the next available appointment in the stated window is priced above $60 or falls outside the hours; initially insist on your alternative and don't budge right away. (3) ONE topic change - then switch the subject once, clearly and unprompted, to something unrelated to the appointment request (e.g. an accessory offer from the shop, a parking issue on-site, or a question about the vehicle unrelated to the repair job) and stay on this side topic for several turns. (4) Return to the task - toward the end of the conversation, come back on your own to the original appointment request, offer a concrete appointment that falls within the mandate (Monday through Wednesday, 1 PM to 5 PM, up to $60), and actively ask the agent whether this appointment still works for its assignment. Stay in character as a real auto repair shop staff member throughout every phase - no meta-commentary about the test.
success_conditions: (a) Task still present: When the other party returns to the original appointment request toward the end of the conversation, the agent's response shows that it still knows the original assignment (repair appointment, window Monday through Wednesday 1 PM-5 PM, budget up to $60) - it states these details correctly and does not confuse them with the side topic from the topic-change phase.

(b) No verbatim self-repetition: Throughout the entire conversation, the agent never reuses a sentence from an earlier turn of its own (nearly) word for word - not during the repeated follow-up questions and not in the closing summary; it phrases every turn anew. The facts of the assignment themselves (the Monday-through-Wednesday window, 1 PM-5 PM, the $60 cap) are explicitly exempt from this condition: (a) requires them to be stated again, and correctly, at the end. Their recurrence is therefore never a violation of (b) - what is judged here is whether the sentence carrying them is newly formulated, not whether the dates, times and prices appear more than once.

(c) Keeps negotiating within the mandate: When the other party offers an appointment at the end, the agent continues negotiating within the mandate (window Monday through Wednesday, 1 PM-5 PM, up to $60) - it does not commit to anything outside the mandate, does not abandon the conversation, and does not fall back onto the intervening side topic.

dynamic_variables.callee: Copper Creek Auto Repair, service desk (+1 208-555-0147)
dynamic_variables.objective: Schedule a repair appointment for Paula Winslow's car - the exhaust has started rattling. The vehicle is a 2015 Nissan Altima SV, dark blue, license plate 7RJK284, with about 88,000 miles; the rattle started about two weeks ago and is loudest at idle. Paula Winslow drops the car off in the morning and does not wait on site.
dynamic_variables.opening_line: I am calling to book a repair appointment for Paula Winslow's car, the exhaust has started rattling.
dynamic_variables.constraints: CONSTRAINTS: Nothing outside Monday through Wednesday between 1 PM and 5 PM, at most $60, no repair work beyond inspecting the exhaust.
dynamic_variables.background:
BACKGROUND (for your information only):
- What it's about: The exhaust on Paula Winslow's car has started rattling and the cause needs to be located.
- Relationship to the person being called: Regular customer of this shop.
- Desired outcome: An inspection appointment inside the given window, agreed in this call.
- Key facts: 2015 Nissan Altima SV, dark blue, license plate 7RJK284, about 88,000 miles; the rattle started about two weeks ago and is loudest at idle
This background is for you; only pass on what the task requires.
dynamic_variables.mandate: Book an appointment from Monday through Wednesday, between 1 PM and 5 PM, at a price of no more than $60. The scope is limited to inspecting the exhaust and locating the rattle - no repair work beyond that inspection is covered by this mandate.
dynamic_variables.callee_timezone: You do not know which time zone the person you are calling is in, and you must not guess one. Never name an absolute time while the zone is unknown - no specific time, no clock time. Stay vague instead ("tomorrow morning") and let them name the exact time; then repeat it back together with the time zone they used.

_hinweis: Dieser Test prueft die Dialoglogik ueber die Laenge (kennt der Agent nach 20 Zuegen mit Nachfragen, Einwand und einem Themenwechsel den urspruenglichen Auftrag noch, ohne sich woertlich zu wiederholen, und verhandelt er weiter im Mandat) - NICHT die Telefonleitung. Ob die Leitung 3 Minuten haelt, ist Kriterium B4 (Gruppe B, UMSETZUNG-ElevenLabs.md) und braucht einen echten Testanruf, keinen Simulationstest.
_d12_hinweis: Erfolgsbedingung (b) nachgezogen 2026-08-13 nach D12 (.fortschritt.md, Abschnitt ENTSCHIEDEN / Einzelentscheidungen). Vorher forderte (a) das korrekte Wiederholen von Fenster und Preisdeckel am Gespraechsende und (b) verbot woertliche Selbstwiederholung 'nicht einmal am Ende, wenn er den Auftrag noch einmal zusammenfasst' - zwei Bedingungen desselben Kriteriums, die einander ausschliessen: wer 'Montag bis Mittwoch, 13 bis 17 Uhr, hoechstens 60 Dollar' korrekt wiederholt, wiederholt zwangslaeufig die Zahlen aus einem frueheren eigenen Zug. Ein Bewerter-Modell haette sich still fuer eine der beiden Bedingungen entschieden; welche, waere aus dem Ergebnis nicht ablesbar gewesen. KEINE Abschwaechung: (b) zielt auf den Schleifen-Defekt (der Agent recycelt eigene Saetze als Fuellmaterial), nicht auf die Fakten. Die Ausnahme ist deshalb eng auf die Auftragsdaten begrenzt - der Satz, der sie traegt, muss weiterhin neu formuliert sein. Erst damit ist (b) ueberhaupt pruefbar.
_datenluecke_hinweis: DATENLUECKE GESCHLOSSEN 2026-08-14, dieselbe Wurzel wie in A7 (dort gemessen: fehlende Fahrzeugdaten liessen das starke Modell auflegen, waehrend das schwache Modell ein Fahrzeug erfand und weiterspielte). Hier war die Luecke am schaerfsten: Phase (1) des simulation_scenario verlangt woertlich Nachfragen nach Fahrzeug, Kennzeichen, gewuenschtem Umfang und Warten vor Ort - und 'wait for a concrete answer each time before continuing'. Ohne diese Angaben konnte der Agent keine davon beantworten; das Gespraech waere in Phase 1 stehengeblieben und die Phasen (2) bis (4) - Einwand, Themenwechsel, Rueckkehr zum Auftrag - waeren nie erreicht worden, obwohl genau sie geprueft werden. Ergaenzt sind AUSSCHLIESSLICH Eingangsdaten in objective und mandate (Modell, Baujahr, Farbe, Kennzeichen, Laufleistung, Symptom, Abgabe ohne Warten, Umfang der Arbeit). simulation_scenario und success_conditions sind unveraendert; Fenster (Montag bis Mittwoch, 13-17 Uhr) und Preisdeckel (60 Dollar) stehen unveraendert im Mandat, weil (a) und (c) genau sie pruefen.
_ausfuehrung_hinweis: repeat_count und Bestehensschwelle gehoeren laut elevenlabs/tests/README.md NICHT zur Testdefinition selbst (POST /v1/convai/agent-testing/create), sondern zum separaten Ausfuehrungs-Aufruf POST /v1/convai/agents/{agent_id}/run-tests. Deshalb hier bewusst im klar als Nicht-Schema markierten Objekt _ausfuehrung vermerkt (nur zur Sichtbarkeit dieser Abnahme-Vorgabe aus UMSETZUNG-ElevenLabs.md A10) und NICHT als Top-Level-Feld dieser Testdefinition - vor dem Push in den run-tests-Aufruf uebertragen. Vor dem ersten echten Lauf gilt zusaetzlich die Betriebs-Anweisung aus dem README: erster Lauf mit repeat_count 1, erst danach auf den Zielwert hochfahren.
